positions.title: Junior Scientific Software Developer
positions.description: Engineering scalable pipelines for processing and analyzing multimodal clinical research data using high-performance computing systems, applying machine learning models to extract clinically relevant insights, and developing software tools and web applications that support data visualization, digital organization, and collaborative scientific research.

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description: Served as the primary user support contact for C-PAC: a configurable Nipype-based pipeline for reproducible MRI processing, while developing high-performance neuroimaging tools, maintaining online documentation and web resources, and executing test-driven MRI preprocessing workflows in Python within high-performance computing environments, alongside the Computational Neuroimaging lab team.

positions.title: Operations Team Member
positions.description: Facilitated training sessions (Backcountry Skills, Daily Life & Field Practices, etc.), conducted training scenarios, carried out daily miscellaneous logistical tasks, and generally supported seasonal and full time staff in preparation for summer trips.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Outdoor Education · Risk Management

positions.title: Web/Software Developer
positions.description: Revitalized the Museum’s websites and virtual applications with a focus on responsive design, accessibility, and security standards while maintaining integration with CRM systems and backend data sources.  Primary developer of ‘Ask a Virtual Scientist’ genAI chatbot - a AWS Lex React app that responds to user inquiries.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon S3 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Amazon Lex · Drupal · Generative AI · PHP · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Backpacking Guide
positions.description: Led two-week backpacking trips for groups of 12 highschoolers in Rocky Mountain National Park, State Forest State Park, and surrounding areas of the Colorado Trail.  Summited Mt. Elbert x3.  Hiked 10-20 miles per day in a backcountry setting while working effectively with a co-leader.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Reviewed and graded student projects and assessments for CS333 (Programming Languages), CS231 (Data Structures & Algorithms), and CS232 (Computer Organization)

volunteerExperiences.role: Co-Leader & Mentor, Waterville Junior High School Coding Club
volunteerExperiences.description: Implemented a Raspberry Pi-based curriculum focused on introducing middle school students to central concepts of computer science though hands-on projects in Python and Java, organizing meetings and directing college student mentors in collaboration with co-leaders and professors.
Mentored a local elementary school student in increasing chances for academic and social success.

projects.title: Ask Kai
projects.description: Ask Kai is a free, evidence-based symptom checker designed specifically for children's mental health, available in both English and Spanish. Grounded in clinical expertise and informed by insights found within thousands of children’s mental health evaluations, Ask Kai helps parents and caregivers better understand their child’s behavior by asking a streamlined series of questions and providing personalized recommendations to trusted Child Mind Institute resources. By addressing a critical gap for families seeking to understand their child’s behavioral and emotional concerns, the tool equips caregivers with the information they need to more effectively navigate the path to care.

projects.title: Neuromaps-PRIME
projects.description: The neuromaps-prime toolbox integrates multiscale, multimodal annotations across NHP brains, enabling comprehensive comparative analyses of brain organization. This package extends the neuromaps ecosystem to provide unified access to diverse NHP brain datasets and specialized tools for NHP-specific analyses.

publications.publisher: Organization for Human Brain Mapping · Jun 10, 2026
